abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic cancer remains one of the most lethal malignancies with limited therapeutic options. This study investigates the anti-cancer effects of eriodyctiol, a natural flavonoid, and its potential as combination therapy with gemcitabine in pancreatic cancer treatment.
METHODS: Molecular docking analysis indicated eriodyctiol-P53 interactions. Pancreatic cancer cells BxPC-3 and Capan-2 were treated with eriodyctiol, and effects were assessed using Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) viability assays, Western blot, immunofluorescence, co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), flow cytometry, and quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Synergistic effects with gemcitabine were evaluated in vitro and validated in xenograft mouse models.
RESULTS: Eriodyctiol demonstrated dose-dependent cytotoxicity in BxPC-3 and Capan-2 cells. Treatment enhanced P53 protein stability and nuclear translocation, upregulated downstream targets p21, BAX, and PUMA, and increased apoptosis. CETSA confirmed direct eriodyctiol-P53 binding, and Co-IP assay revealed the disruption of MDM2-P53 interaction by eriodyctiol treatment. Rescue experiments confirmed P53-dependent, caspase-3-mediated apoptosis induced by eriodyctiol. Importantly, combination with gemcitabine showed strong synergistic effects in vitro and enhanced anti-tumor efficacy in vivo.
CONCLUSIONS: Eriodyctiol exhibits potent anti-cancer activity through P53 binding and MDM2-P53 interaction disruption, leading to P53-dependent apoptosis. The compound shows promise as a novel therapeutic strategy that synergistically enhances gemcitabine efficacy in pancreatic cancer treatment.
key_points_ko: 에리오디크티올은 MDM2-P53 상호작용을 차단하여 P53 의존성 암세포 사멸을 유도했습니다.
췌장암 세포주(BxPC-3, Capan-2) 실험에서 에리오디크티올은 용량 의존적인 항암 효과를 나타냈습니다.
세포 및 마우스 이식 모델에서 젬시타빈과의 병용 치료는 강력한 항암 시너지 효과를 입증했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 천연 플라보노이드 성분인 에리오디크티올(eriodyctiol)의 췌장암 치료 효과와 젬시타빈(gemcitabine)과의 병용 효과를 확인한 전임상 연구입니다. 에리오디크티올은 MDM2와 P53 단백질 간의 결합을 차단하여 P53 단백질을 안정화하고 세포사멸(apoptosis)을 유도했습니다. 또한 세포 및 마우스 모델에서 젬시타빈과 병용 투여했을 때 항암 효과가 크게 향상되는 시너지 효과를 보였습니다.
title: Eriodyctiol induces P53-dependent apoptosis in pancreatic cancer through disruption of MDM2-P53 interaction and synergistically enhances gemcitabine efficacy
